name: pillar_morph2
desc: The pink marbled goo pillar holding the small black witch cat slowly bubbles and squelches, swelling and bulging, goo lumps grow outward into huge massive muscular shoulders and thick arms spreading straight out sideways, and a grinning toothy crocodile head with spikes rises up behind the cat, gradually transforming into a huge hulking macho paint crocodile monster that holds the cat on its chest. Gooey, wet, gradual transformation.
